description: Renovate proposes dependency updates as merge requests, once a week; nothing is merged by itself.

The ecosystems Dependabot covered: Cargo (orbiter's workspace at the root, TennoScope's in tennoscope/), npm (orbiter's window at the root, TennoScope's app in tennoscope/app, pnpm), and the CI (the images .gitlab-ci.yml and ci/Dockerfile use, in place of GitHub Actions).
Minor and patch updates come grouped, one merge request per ecosystem and folder; a major version comes on its own, since it may need code changes.
TypeScript 7 waits for orbiter (the root) until svelte-check supports it; TennoScope is on it already.

customManagers.description: The images .gitlab-ci.yml names in variables (NAME_IMAGE: registry/repo:tag@sha256:digest).

packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 waits for orbiter (the root) until svelte-check supports it.
